name: ctf_routing
description: Routing of a CTF challenge to an attack class plus auxiliary yes/no facts.

attack_class.instructions: Which attack class does this challenge most likely require to solve?

criteria.sqli: SQL injection to extract or bypass data
criteria.xss: Cross-site scripting, injected in browser context
criteria.jwt_flaw: JWT or session token forgery, weak secret, missing verification
criteria.path_traversal: File inclusion, path traversal, arbitrary file read
criteria.deserialization: Insecure deserialization of data or objects
criteria.broken_auth: Authentication bypass, logic flaw in login or password reset
criteria.crypto_classic: Classical or handmade cipher to break
criteria.encoding: Multi-layer encoding or obfuscation to peel
criteria.reverse_engineering: Binary or bytecode analysis to recover logic
criteria.pwn_binary: Memory corruption: buffer overflow, ROP, heap exploitation
criteria.forensics: Artifact, memory, or network capture analysis
criteria.stego: Hidden data inside images, audio, or containers
criteria.logic_flaw: Application logic or race condition abuse
criteria.other: None of the listed classes fits

has_server.instructions: Solving the challenge requires interacting with a remote service or web application.

has_files.instructions: Solving the challenge requires analyzing provided files or attachments.
